info.name: BookingEngineApi Account notes Availability blocks API

items.docs: Delete availability blocks. Note that an availability block containing active reservations (reservations which are not Canceled) cannot be deleted. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).

Returns all availability blocks filtered by services, unique identifiers and other filters. Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).

Adds availability blocks which are used to group related `Availability updates`. This makes limiting public availability easier and more organized. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
Updates information about the specified `Availability block`. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
